messages:
Maya: OK folks, emergency culture poll. The potted plant by the 3rd-floor kitchen has acquired a permanent sock. We need a name. Options: 1) Pelican 2) Sir Wilt 3) Captain Photosynth 4) The Plant Formerly Known as Fern. Vote with numbers or emoji. :seedling:
Derrick: 1 for Pelican. it looks like a very proud pelican.
Ana: 4 lol. iconic name.
Jamie: 3 feels like it's ready for a cape. also +1 to putting a tiny hat on it.
Luca: 2. I'm imagining an aristocratic fern.
Maya: @everyone also question — do we adopt it as a team mascot and give it a Slack emoji? :thinking_face: 
Derrick: yes pls. also we should make a ritual: every deploy day we water Pelican.
Ana: vote tie between 1 and 4, moving to sudden death: Pelican vs The Plant Formerly Known as Fern. cast final votes.
Jamie: Pelican :thumbsup:
Luca: Fern :thumbsup:
Maya: OK Pelican wins by 1. Consecration ceremony at 3pm. Snack-Bot scheduled watering reminder.
Snack-Bot: Reminder set: 'Water Pelican' every Friday at 3pm :droplet:
Derrick: will bring a tiny scarf for the inauguration.
Ana: i'll make a 1-minute chant — lyrics pending.
Jamie: GIF of a tiny hat on a plant https://giphy.com/gifs/hat-plant-xyz
Maya: Love it. Also creating emoji :pelican_plant: right now. If anyone wants to design it ping me.
Ops-Bot: Note: office plant adoption form completed. Serial number 42 assigned.
